summary.name: DoNotPay
summary.one_liner: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer rights service offering 100+ tools to fight companies, cancel subscriptions, find missing money, and handle bureaucracy.
use_cases: Cancel unwanted subscriptions and free trials
Report and seek compensation for robocalls
Send letters and proof of mailing to companies or agencies
summary.what_it_does: The page describes DoNotPay as an AI service that helps users fight large corporations, protect privacy, find hidden money, and deal with bureaucracy. It offers a Free Trial Card, a secure virtual card that the page says blocks surprise charges with auto-decline. It lists categories including Find Missing Money, Fight Scammers, Beat Bureaucracy, and Protect Your Privacy. Testimonials mention sending letters through the service with proof of mailing and contesting parking tickets. The page says it has 100+ AI-powered tools, and it links to articles on refunds, chargebacks, and reporting robocalls.
notable: Free Trial Card: virtual card with auto-decline to block surprise charges
Letter sending with proof of mailing tracked in a dashboard (per user testimonial)
Established 2015; ABA Brown Award for access to justice (per page)
caveats: Listed as paid in the source directory; the page itself does not state specific prices
Page states its self-help tools are not guaranteed to help in every situation
Testimonials and savings claims are user-reported, not verified
